=== TEMPLATE DOCUMENTATION ===
PARAMETERS SECTION:
=- Title: The name displayed in The calculator dropdown
=- Description: Brief Description shown in The calculator selector
- Icon: Emoji icon for the calculator (e.g., 🧪, ⚗️, 🌡️, 🧊, 💨)
- Warning Tolerance: Decimal (e.g., 0.05 = 5%) - values within this range show as 'close'
- Incorrect Tolerance: Decimal (e.g., 0.1 = 10%) - values beyond this are marked incorrect
- Trials: Number of trials (1 or 2) - determines column layout
- Template: Set to 'true' to exclude from calculator list (for templates only)
ENTRY TYPES:
=- Data: Student enters a numeric value (creates input box)
=- Calculated: Formula-based value that students calculate and enter
- Choice: Dropdown selection from semicolon-separated options (e.g., A; B; C; D)
=- Text: Free-form Text entry (e.g., compound names, unknown identifiers)
TABLE COLUMNS:
- Section: Groups rows under a header (e.g., 'Part 1: Data Collection')
- Subsection: Sub-grouping within a section (e.g., 'Data', 'Calculations')
- DataRef1/DataRef2: Cell reference for Trial 1/2 (e.g., =F5, =G5)
=- Label: Description shown to The Student
- Trial 1/Trial 2: Value or formula (use NA for single-trial cells)
=- Unit: Unit of measurement (e.g., g, mL, mol, ˚C)
=- entry Type: One of Data, Calculated, Choice, or Text
FORMULAS:
- Start with = sign (e.g., =F8-F5)
=- reference cells by their DataRef (e.g., F5, G5)
- Supported: +, -, *, /, ^, parentheses
- Use 10^(-F5) for exponents with cell references
- For averages, use (A+B+C)/3 instead of AVERAGE()
- Use NA in Trial 2 column for values calculated from both trials
SECTIONS & SUBSECTIONS:
=- to create a Section header: Put name in Section column, leave other columns empty
- To create a subsection: Put name in Subsection column (e.g., 'Data', 'Calculations')
- Subsections help organize the 'Check Work' button groupings
